reasons.text: The claimed purchase date of 2023-07-27 is before the program's sale window of 2023-10-01 to 2023-12-31, so the unit was not sold under the recall's covered sale period.
The label photo is legible and shows model FCRG3051BS, which is a recalled model.
The serial VF34618277 is within the recalled range and the date code October 2023 is within the recalled production window, so the unit itself is covered; the denial rests on the purchase date alone.
